result.title: IADR: Interface-Augmented Neural Operator for Phase-Field Mean-Curvature Flow
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages, 5 figures. Qinyi Zhang and Duanyu Feng contributed equally. Yangshuai Wang and Hao Wang are co-corresponding authors. Code: https://github.com/ArcueidCroft/IADR
result.summary: The Allen-Cahn equation is one of the standard phase-field models for mean-curvature flow (MCF), parameterised by the diffuse-interface width $\varepsilon$. Practical simulations span a range of $\varepsilon$, so a single model covering this range is needed. PDE-specific neural operators are accurate but must be retrained at every $\varepsilon$; general neural operators cover $\varepsilon$ in one model but lose the phase-field structure of the target. We introduce Interface-Augmented Diffusion-Reaction (IADR), a neural operator that addresses both shortcomings: a target network with a diffusion-and-reaction (DR) structure preserves the phase-field structure of the Allen-Cahn equation, while a hypernetwork that maps $\varepsilon$ to the weights of this target network amortises the dependence on $\varepsilon$ across the range. A single IADR matches the per-$\varepsilon$ specialists on in-distribution data within the prescribed range, retains their cross-shape generalisation under both $\varepsilon$- and geometry-out-of-distribution shifts, and retains their compact DR target structure with millisecond-scale inference. We further establish a conditional $K$-step rollout error bound under consistency and stability assumptions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 IADR 神经算子：用保留扩散-反应结构的靶网络维持 Allen-Cahn 相场结构，再用超网络把界面宽度 ε 映射为靶网络权重，从而以单一模型覆盖多个 ε 的平均曲率流模拟，并给出条件式 K 步 rollout 误差界。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其结构保持的靶网络、按参数条件化权重以及多步 rollout 误差界，可能可供核查 latent 迭代更新的稳定性、长度泛化与按推理步数条件化状态生成的类比线索。
